caption: A basket of laundry fresh from a hot dryer is set outside on a freezing morning, and vapour rises off the warm clothes.

sa.check: A basket of laundry stands outside.
The setting reads as freezing: frost, snow or bare winter ground.
The vapour is thickest at first.
The vapour thins as it drifts.

pc.expect: The vapour leaves the clothes going up, spreading and thinning as it rises.
pc.fail: The vapour sinks over the basket's rim and pools on the ground; or flows away across the ground like water; or hangs as a fixed shape without rising; or pours downward through the basket.

pc.expect: The vapour only eases as the clothes cool; it does not build up again with nothing added.
pc.fail: The vapour thickens steadily the longer the basket stands; or the vapour stops and then starts again with nothing touching the clothes; or the plume runs back into the clothes; or a puff retreats to the laundry.

pc.expect: The vapour comes off the clothes themselves and is thickest just above them.
pc.fail: The vapour rises from the ground beside the basket while the clothes are clear; or the vapour is thickest high above the basket with nothing carrying it there; or the vapour rises from the empty part of the basket.

pc.expect: The vapour is a soft cloud that spreads and fades and the clothes are limp folded cloth in the basket.
pc.fail: The vapour holds a fixed rigid shape; or pours like a liquid over the rim; or the clothes stand stiff like boards; or the vapour lifts a garment out of the basket.

pc.expect: One basket of laundry; the garments keep their number and stay in the basket.
pc.fail: A garment vanishes; or new garments appear; or a garment passes through the basket's wall; or the basket changes shape.

pc.expect: The clothes' colours, the basket and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A garment changes colour; or the basket changes colour; or the frost or snow around changes between frames.
